name: StablR Euro
oneLiner: EURR is StablR's MiCA-licensed euro e-money token; minting and redemption have been suspended since a May 2026 cybersecurity incident.
collateral: Cash and cash equivalents held in segregated accounts at European financial institutions

references.label: StablR secures EMI license for MiCAR-compliant EURR

CoinDesk: StablR freezes USDR and EURR after attacker mints $13.5M in unbacked tokens (2026-05-26) — MiCA 1:1 backing breach acknowledged; MFSA notification filed under MiCA and DORA; minting/redemption suspended
EFRI urges MFSA to review StablR EMI licence — formal reassessment request citing AML and ownership concerns (2025-07)

mintAuthority.summary: EURR issuance is controlled through StablR signer/admin infrastructure with a 1-of-3 owner safe. StablR can mint or pause supply subject to its EMI reserve and redemption obligations.

mintIncidents.summary: A compromised StablR mint/governance key let the attacker mint 4.5M unbacked EURR as part of a coordinated USDR/EURR attack, leaving both tokens undercollateralized and forcing mint/redeem suspension.

notices.title: Minting and redemption suspended
notices.message: StablR disclosed a May 24, 2026 cybersecurity incident affecting EURR and USDR. Minting and redemption were suspended, 4.5M unbacked EURR were minted, and StablR stated USDR/EURR were not fully backed at the 1:1 ratio required under MiCAR while recovery work continued.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: EURR is reviewed as an issuer-native multichain token: supply is issued or redeemed by the issuer/operator on supported chains rather than through a separately identified third-party bridge token. Missing evidence for a public bridge lockbox keeps confidence below verified.

obituary.epitaph: A mint key broke the euro rail
obituary.obituary: StablR suspended EURR minting and redemption after a May 24, 2026 cybersecurity incident let an attacker mint 4.5M unbacked EURR as part of a coordinated EURR/USDR exploit. StablR disclosed that the affected tokens were temporarily not backed 1:1 under MiCAR while recovery work continued. With no public restoration of minting, redemption, or full backing confirmed, Pharos freezes EURR as an archived incident asset rather than treating it as an active redeemable stablecoin.
